new_today_news.headline: Electric Vacuum Sewer Trucks Are Coming: Are They Ready for Real-World Wastewater Operations?
new_today_news.summary: Analysis of electric vacuum sewer truck readiness for wastewater operations, examining adoption drivers, infrastructure requirements, cost implications, and reliability concerns. Early pilot programs have shown encouraging results, but fleet operators continue monitoring long-term performance before full fleet conversion.

recent_news.headline: Earnings Inflection Talk And Margin Focus Might Change The Case For Investing In Darling Ingredients (DAR)
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported Q1 2026 revenues matching analyst expectations but missed adjusted operating income estimates. Management described the quarter as an inflection point for earnings power in its core business and Diamond Green Diesel joint venture. A new U.S. patent for Nextida GC collagen peptide has heightened focus on margin improvement and debt reduction.

recent_news.headline: Royal Waste Services Expands Mack LR Electric Fleet
recent_news.summary: Royal Waste Services, a Waste Connections subsidiary, ordered three additional Mack LR Electric refuse trucks funded by the New York Truck Voucher Incentive Program. The order follows successful deployment of an initial truck in December 2025, which accumulated over 500 miles and collected 600 tons of waste with zero downtime.
